findings.title: Container runs a shell or interpreter with nothing to do
findings.cause: container etl exits with code 0 as soon as it starts: it sets no command, and image python's default command is an interpreter (python3), and an interpreter given no program, no terminal and no input reads its program from that input, finds it empty and exits at once, and the kubelet restarts it; Deployment etl has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container etl exited with code 0 (Completed), restarted 7 times
container etl's image, command and args

findings.fix: Give the container its program, the script the image copies in, as its command or args (python3 app.py); to keep it alive for debugging, run sleep infinity, and use kubectl debug or kubectl run -it for an interactive session.
